messages:
Ana: Hey team — noticed the ruby sampleapp CI started failing after the auth/retry tweak landed. local `bundle install` passes but CI errors during native gem install (ffi).
Jordan: ugh, can you paste the failing lines?
Ana: sure:
```
Fetching ffi 1.15.5 (x64-mingw32)
Building native extensions.
ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
/opt/rubies/ruby-2.7.6/bin/ruby -e "require 'mkmf'"
checking for ffi_call() in -lffi... no

An error occurred while installing ffi (1.15.5), and Bundler cannot continue.
```
Sam: looks like the CI windows image upgraded libffi system package and binary gem build now mismatches. pinning ffi in Gemfile.lock usually helps.
Maria: also, I noticed a parity thing: the ruby client still requeues immediately on 429 instead of honoring Retry-After header. that might be why tests bombard the installer when there's transient throttling. @Jordan was that backported?
Jordan: the main retry change landed in #1234 but I didn't backport it to the ruby SDK branches. i have a draft fix that parses Retry-After and sleeps accordingly, will push it today.
Ana: opened a tiny issue + draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/87 (contains repro and suggested gem pin). ci shows failing on windows matrix only.
devex-bot: PR created by Jordan — CI: pending, reviewers requested: @Sam @Maria
Sam: quick glance — the gemspec change is minimal, LGTM with one nit about the dev dependency version.
Maria: can we also add a focused integration test for the Retry-After case? I pushed a small test in the draft PR that fakes a 429 with header and asserts wait behavior.
Jordan: thanks — I'll merge the retry-backport + test, then we can update the sampleapp to stop pinning if system image is stable.
Ana: to reproduce locally on windows runner: `docker run --rm -e BUNDLER_VERSION=2.3 ruby:2.7-buster bash -lc "bundle install"` — CI uses Bundler 2.3 on that image so mismatch is surprising.
Sam: can we standardize bundler version in CI matrix to avoid these flakes? maybe add `before_install: gem install bundler -v 2.3.26` step.
Jordan: good call. i'll add that to the workflow in the PR.
Ana: once merged, can someone cut a patch release for the ruby SDK? this is causing onboarding friction for new users following the quickstart.
Sam: I can cut 0.3.5 after merge and green CI. please add a changelog line under Unreleased.
Maria: +1. also we should add a short note in the quickstart about possible native build issues and the bundler workaround.
Jordan: done — updated PR with changelog entry and workflow pin. merging after CI passes.
Ana: thanks all, greatly appreciated :thumbsup:
Sam: merging & cutting patch after green.
Maria: will follow up to add the quickstart note.
devex-bot: CI passed for PR #87, merged by Sam. Release pipeline triggered.
